evidence_claim: Buffer-mutating paths undo_redo (ops.rs:472-500), replace_all Replaced::Lines (ops.rs:1264-1291) and apply_outcome (ops.rs:191-210) never call refresh_auto_language: undoing a JSON paste back to empty keeps JSON highlighting and the stale automatic language persists, violating clear-on-empty and keep-current semantics.

sample() truncation loop keeps appending newline plus bytes from subsequent lines after a UTF-8-boundary cut because it never stops when prefix(line, room).len() < room; the bounded sample can include fragments of lines that follow a truncated line.

A whitespace-only 4KB sample resolves Detected::Plain and clears the pane language although non-whitespace content exists beyond the bounded sample; empty-clear must judge the pane content, not just the sample.

README states 'Anything else stays plain text', contradicting the implemented no-flicker behavior where an inconclusive detection keeps the current language (asserted by test inconclusive_edits_keep_the_current_language).
